language_gate.method: English whole-query threshold (langdetect >=.95 or Lingua >=.80), plus sentence/span checks. Ambiguous fragments need English context and either English ranked first (>=.35), or English >=.15 with two English function-word anchors. Confident foreign fragments do not inherit context.
language_gate.limitation: Heuristic scores are not calibrated clinical confidence. Short technical phrases can be overblocked; mixed-language text can still be missed.
